description: The deployment's own declaration of what it is: a house (its own agents, its own fence) or a commons (a system governing people's participation in the world). Admitted once, by the node key, never superseded; printed beside the identities line on every verifier run, where the reader's own posture — not this declaration — decides whether badge-only persons are a finding.

claims: the node key declared, at the recorded position, whether this deployment governs people's participation in the world
doesNotClaim: that the declaration is true — the identities line printed beside it is the evidence, and the reader's posture decides what it means
